impact: A comparison cohort can be contaminated by partial-source or unrelated observed metrics and generate misleading descriptive effect estimates; does not explain every historical missing window.
fix: Reuse isSourceQualifiedSocialSnapshot to select cohort only when exact tenant/post, provider external ID in immutable source event, actual observed_at in original 24/48/72h +/-6h interval and finite nonnegative metric are present. No source backfill, synthetic metric, extra collector or modified threshold.
prevention_rule: Before any cohort-based social learning, prove source quality, tenant/post/provider event identity and exact actual 24/48/72h measurement interval on every member, not just the target; fail closed and keep unknown measurements uncounted.
